title: @kirigami/plugin-highlight options
description: Options for the `@kirigami/plugin-highlight` entry under `plugins:` in kirigami.yaml.

languages.description: Languages to register with highlight.js. Either an explicit list of language names, or the string "all" for the full build (~190 languages, slower). Unknown names are skipped with a warning.

theme.description: Which theme stylesheet to append to every sass task. "auto" = light baseline + dark under prefers-color-scheme/[data-theme]. "none" appends nothing (you @use the mixin yourself).

autodetect.description: Guess the language of code blocks that have no language- class, restricted to the registered set.

embedFont.description: Append the embedded JetBrains Mono @font-face (~39 KB base64 woff2) to every sass task.

copyButton.description: Add a hover "Copy" button to every code block. Bundles a small script into every esbuild task (needs one) and appends the button styles to every sass task.

tag.description: Register the <highlight lang="…">…</highlight> authoring tag (PHP-side, via the prepros:php hook). It emits <pre><code class="language-…">; the highlighting itself still happens in the prepros:html pass.
